summary: iter86 — Full backend+web+mobile validation of the new Emergent-managed Google sign-in + full multi-tenancy (Option B) on the paper-trading app. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_multi_tenant_auth.py covering owner-unchanged, Google-user isolation, per-tenant mutation isolation (manual order, onboarding paper-setup, PUT /api/settings), anonymous 403s, and invalid Google session_id → 401. Web: owner-login-dialog opens from header 'Sign In', shows Continue-with-Google button (data-testid=google-signin-button) above owner email/password, owner login flips UI to authed (owner-session pill visible). Mobile (Expo web preview @ 390x844): login screen shows Continue-with-Google (testID=google-signin-btn) ABOVE owner email/password and owner login navigates into the app. Real Google OAuth redirect is external so it was verified only up to button presence + client-side loginWithGoogle wiring, exactly as scoped in the review request.

code_review_findings.tenancy_layer: VERIFIED /app/backend/tenancy.py: resolve_principal() correctly walks owner-JWT → bearer-session → cookie-session; ensure_provisioned() lazily creates portfolio+settings docs with id 'tenant_<user_id>' and forces trading_mode='PAPER'. session TTL 7 days, upsert on Google user by email. exchange_session_id() raises ValueError on non-200 from Emergent, which the endpoint maps to HTTP 401 (verified live).
code_review_findings.tenant_ctx: VERIFIED /app/backend/tenant_ctx.py: owner tenant preserves legacy doc id 'singleton'; per-user tenant uses 'tenant_<id>'; tenant_trade_filter() for owner includes legacy rows via $in:[OWNER_TENANT, None]. Backward-compatible.
code_review_findings.google_session_endpoint: VERIFIED /app/backend/server.py L1463 POST /api/auth/google/session sets HttpOnly cookie (web transport) AND returns session_token (mobile Bearer) — same token, both surfaces work.
code_review_findings.frontend_web_auth: VERIFIED /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx: readSessionId reads session_id from either URL fragment or query; on return from Emergent exchanges via api.googleSession, stores session_token in localStorage TOKEN_KEY. loginWithGoogle redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/. OwnerAuthControl exposes data-testid=google-signin-button in the login dialog and the owner-session pill + owner-logout-button post-auth.
code_review_findings.frontend_mobile_auth: VERIFIED /app/mobile/src/auth.tsx + /app/mobile/app/login.tsx: web platform uses window.location redirect, native uses WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync + Linking.getInitialURL/hot event listener. session_token stored via SecureStore (native) / same TOKEN_KEY on web. testID=google-signin-btn on the Google button (mobile spec matches review request).

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: manual order note is hardcoded to 'MANUAL BUY (owner)' even when the caller is a Google user — cosmetic, no isolation impact but worth aligning with the multi-tenant model.

The Continue-with-Google button opens the real Emergent OAuth redirect (external). Full end-to-end Google sign-in cannot be validated in automation; confirmed via seeded session_token per /app/memory/test_credentials.md (test_session_qa01) that ALL user-scoped endpoints behave exactly as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: Tenancy layer cleanly separated (tenancy.py + tenant_ctx.py + ContextVar) — legacy owner paths are byte-for-byte identical (doc id 'singleton', unchanged filter), and Google users get their own '/tenant_<user_id>' book on first hit.

Both surfaces (web + mobile) reuse the SAME TOKEN_KEY for owner JWT AND Google session_token — the backend resolver accepts either transport (Bearer for mobile, cookie or Bearer for web) which keeps the shared axios/fetch client trivial.
Invalid Google session_id correctly surfaces as HTTP 401 (not 500) — this was one of the explicit acceptance criteria and passes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (web + mobile owner login flows PASS; Google button + testids verified on both)
